Use it to get a team's id, or to check which teams a name means before creating a calendar from it, since "giants" is two teams. tools.name: get_all_games
tools.description: Gets every game live right now in every league TeamCalendar follows, grouped by league in display order, each game with its score and where it is, as the league's board shows it. Pass a league code for that league's live games alone. For a screen that shows every live game at once.

tools.name: get_calendar_view
tools.description: Gets a calendar by its address, the slug at the end of its link: its links, its teams and seasons, and its games between two instants, the next twelve months when none are given. Use it when someone shares a TeamCalendar link.

tools.name: get_field_session
tools.description: Gets one session's scoreboard by league code, Grand Prix slug, season and stage, such as f1, monaco-grand-prix, 2027 and race: its state, how many laps it has run while live, and its whole classification (place, driver, team, time or gap, laps, grid, fastest lap), with the weekend's other sessions.

tools.name: get_game_scoreboard
tools.description: Gets one game's scoreboard by game id: both clubs, its state, its line score in the league's columns, and where and when it is played. Answers "what was the score" or "when does it start" for one game.

tools.name: get_highlight
tools.description: What the home page highlights for a region: a state, province, country or city. An operator's choice when there is one; otherwise the league the country governs (England's, Mexico's), or else the most popular clubs whose venue is in the region. tools.description: Gets a league's scoreboard by league code: today's games and scores, the previous game day's finals and the games of the next three game days. Pass a date for another day, or a team id for that team's recent finals.

tools.name: get_league_bracket
tools.description: Gets a tournament's bracket by league code: each pool's table, then every knockout slot with where its two sides come from ("winner of group A", "winner of match 49"), the teams filling them once decided, the games played in it and who went on. tools.name: get_league_playoffs
tools.description: Gets a league's latest playoff season by league code, with its next four games and whether the playoffs are on now.

tools.name: get_league_portal
tools.description: Gets a racing series' season by league code, such as f1: the next sessions with their start times, every Grand Prix of the season in round order with its circuit, dates and winner, the latest race's podium, and the drivers' and constructors' championships. tools.name: get_league_slate
tools.description: Gets a league's games from today through the next few days, grouped by day in the league's day zone, with each game's score as the board shows it and its permalink key. Pass days=1 for today alone, or a team id for that club's games. Answers "what games are on today" and "who plays this week".

tools.name: get_league_standings
tools.description: Gets a league's standings by league code: every club that plays in its current season, in table order, with its place, its regular-season record in the league's columns and, where the league ranks on points, its points. Answers "who leads the league" and "where are they in the standings".

tools.description: Lists the leagues TeamCalendar follows, such as the NBA or NFL, optionally by sport code, ISO country code (US, GB) or gender (men, women, mixed). tools.description: Gets a Grand Prix weekend by league code and slug, such as f1 and monaco-grand-prix: where it is held, every session with its start and end time, each session's classification once it has one, and the winner of every other edition. Answers "what time is the Monaco Grand Prix", "when is qualifying" a

tools.name: get_series_team
tools.description: Gets a racing team's current season by team id, such as a Formula 1 constructor's: its place, points and wins in the constructors' championship, its drivers, the next session with its start time, and every Grand Prix of the season in date order with its track and how the team's cars finished the rac

tools.name: get_sports
tools.description: Lists the sports TeamCalendar follows, such as basketball and hockey, each named in the reader's language. A sport's code filters get_leagues.

tools.name: get_team_glance
tools.description: Gets one club's next three games and its last three finals, with the league's line-score columns. Takes the id find_teams or list_teams gives. Answers "when is the next game" and "how did the last ones go".

tools.name: get_team_schedule
tools.description: Lists one team's games, home and away, between two instants: the next twelve months when none are given. Takes the id find_teams or list_teams gives. Answers a question about a team's schedule without creating a calendar.

tools.name: get_team_season
tools.description: Gets one club's season: every game in it, pre-season, regular season and post-season, each with the club's result and its record after it, and every season held for the club. Takes the id find_teams or list_teams gives, and a season slug such as 2026 or 2025-2026; without one, the current season. An

tools.name: list_league_season_slugs
tools.description: Lists the seasons a league has games in, oldest first, by the slug a club's season page takes: 2026, or 2025-2026 for a league whose season spans two years. Not the stored season codes list_seasons gives.

tools.name: list_seasons
tools.description: Lists a league's seasons by league code, such as its regular season and playoffs. Pass season ids to create_composed_calendar to follow only those seasons.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Lists a league's teams by league code, such as NBA, ordered by name. A team's id is what get_team_schedule and create_composed_calendar take; find_teams finds one by name instead.

tools.name: list_upcoming_leagues
tools.description: Lists the leagues with a game or session being played or starting within the next week, in display order, each with the start of its next one, whether it plays today in its own day zone, and, for a racing series, the session in play or next. Answers "which leagues are playing now".

tools.description: One published post, by its path, ready for a page: its body rendered and its head's tags. A draft, an archived post and no post at all are the same not found.

tools.description: Published posts, newest first, at a path and beneath it, or about one thing.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_series_driver" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_named_calendar, get_team_season, get_published_blog_post, list_published_blog_posts · Private data: get_league_standings, get_team_season · Public sink: get_team_season, get_published_blog_post · Destructive: get_field_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_named_calendar, get_team_season, get_published_blog_post, list_published_blog_posts · Private data: get_league_standings, get_team_season · Public sink: get_team_season, get_published_blog_post · Destructive: get_field_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
